scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,WEB" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
